about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the foundation module control becomes the workspace package @purin-labs/control in foundation/control. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder. sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package: the manifest and the tsconfig of the new package; the versions of devDependencies come from versionsFrom. edits: text edits of the files that name a root folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs, and of a path that is no import; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again. The package holds the two sides of the module apart: worker/ for the Worker files (services/platform/src/control/ and gateway/request-helpers.ts) and portal/ for the Portal files (apps/portal/src/). The tsconfig of the package reads worker/ only; the Portal type check checks each file of portal/ that the Portal imports, with the DOM types. package.typeCheck false: the package has no check:types script of its own. Its own files read the Env keys ORGANISATION (worker/credential-revocation-policy.ts, worker/routes/access-control-mutations.ts) and CASE (worker/routes/access-control.ts), which services/platform/src/actors/organisation.ts and actors/case.ts (workers/platform) merge with declare module of @purin-labs/kernel/env. Through @purin-labs/tenancy, @purin-labs/actor-runtime and @purin-labs/authority the program also lacks SESSION and CONNECTOR. The package alone gives 51 errors, 6 of them in its own files. The Worker program checks its files.

edits.why: the Portal lints and the ESLint rules of the Portal source read the Portal side of the package
